newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott adds 3 Ritz Carlton hotels.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott adds 3 Ritz Carlton hotels.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp said Thursday it had added three Ritz-Carlton hotels to its portfolio for a total investment of about $331 million.
The hotels will continue to be operated by Ritz-Carlton, a statement from Host Marriott said.
Host Marriott said it acquired a majority interest in a newly-formed partnership that owns the 463-room Ritz-Carlton in Naples, Florida and the 553-room Ritz-Carlton, Buckhead in Atlanta.

As part of this transaction, the capital contributed by Host Marriott was used to reduce indebtedness to about $224 million. This indebtedness, which has been assumed by the newly-formed partnership, is fixed-rate non-recourse mortgage debt.
Host Marriott also purchased the 447-room Ritz-Carlton in downtown Atlanta.
The hotels are expected to generate about $41 million of Earnings Before Interest Expense, Taxes, Depreciation, Amortization and other non-cash items (EBITDA) for the full year 1996.

These transactions bring Host Marriott's total acquisitions for 1996 to more than $1.1 billion, the company said, adding that it feels confident that it will achieve its previously announced acquisition target of $1.3 billion.
